exact_passages.quote: AirTrunk, the Blackstone-owned data centre operator, has obtained a US$2.3 billion green loan from a syndicate of 30 lenders to fund its JHB2 hyperscale facility in Johor, Malaysia. This marks the company’s largest single-asset financing to date

control_or_dependency.known: AirTrunk (the operator of JHB1 and offtaker of the VPPA) has been owned by a Blackstone-led consortium incl. CPP Investments since late 2024 (reported)
control_or_dependency.not_known: governance/control arrangements over JHB1 or the VPPA post-acquisition; any lender security or covenants linking financiers to operations; dependency of JHB1 on the VPPA or on any specific generator
control_or_dependency.counterparty_concentration: the same corporate group (AirTrunk) sits on both sides of the JHB1 (facility) and VPPA (offtake) relationships — group-internal linkage, not evidence of third-party dependency

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The ib vogt VPPA supplies JHB1 with electricity.
falsification_attempts.attempts: Searched both accessible sources (ib vogt release; ICD Nova) for any passage naming JHB1 in connection with the VPPA or the solar farm's output.
falsification_attempts.result: FAILED TO CONFIRM: no accessible passage connects the solar farm to JHB1's supply; the sole juxtaposition is the CTO's separate development statement. Media phrasing elsewhere ('to power Malaysia data centre') is an outlet summary, not a supply record.
falsification_attempts.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED — retained as an explicit unknown; the strong claim is rejected as unproven.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The US$2.3B green loan finances JHB1.
falsification_attempts.attempts: Checked the financing article's funded-asset naming.
falsification_attempts.result: FALSIFIED by the source's own wording: the loan funds 'its JHB2 hyperscale facility' — a different building at the same campus company. JHB1 attribution would contradict the cited passage.
falsification_attempts.verdict: FALSIFIED (as stated); campus-grain financing must not be attributed to JHB1.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: Blackstone ownership gives Blackstone control over JHB1's energy arrangements.
falsification_attempts.attempts: Looked for governance/management documentation post-acquisition among accessible sources; none found (Blackstone release 404; no filings retrieved).
falsification_attempts.result: No evidence either way; ownership of the company is reported, internal decision rights are not.
falsification_attempts.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED — unknown; ownership and control are distinct and only the former is (reportedly) documented.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The 30-lender syndicate holds influence over the VPPA or JHB1 operations.
falsification_attempts.attempts: Looked for security packages, covenants or lender roles beyond arrangement (ICD Nova names coordinators for JHB2 only).
falsification_attempts.result: Nothing accessible links lenders to operational or energy decisions.
falsification_attempts.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED — financing does not imply control; recorded as unknown.
